map_role: Sibling 03 - Buried Assay Interchange / Seed-Vault Croft
density_profile: Dense irregular roof-enclosed intake, laboratory, quarantine and refuge inside a thick geological mass. Vast sparse exterior and two largely vacant underground relief pockets.

route_grammar.primary: An entered four-cell intake, diagnosis, isolation, refuge network over a continuous rock-enclosed service spine
route_grammar.alternate: Two independent short branch-rejoin dry service routes, one under receiving and diagnosis, another under quarantine and refuge
route_grammar.recovery: Separate lower loops admit 31x27 full hulls; a physical diagnostic wicket obstruction leaves all other literal stations reachable

strong_motifs: real unlike receiving, diagnostic and isolation equipment at human scale
two short independently usable below-grade return corridors
interesting_relationships: Unlike the aerial trestles, four chambers occupy a single continuous mass but use different interior proportions and threshold geometry
Two small return branches connect pairs of distant chambers without occupying the whole canvas underground
The intake, assay, isolation and refuge have distinct large mechanical interfaces, not identical palettes

authoring_affordances.use: Staffed freight encounter or extra sample racks
Enlarge diagnostic machine or trigger a later scripted sequence

setpiece_candidates.name: Cold courier arrival
setpiece_candidates.exits: Western exterior and interior receiving room

setpiece_candidates.name: Sample drum activation
setpiece_candidates.exits: Room side passage and service spine

procedural_exemplar_value: Thick geological envelope over Midge-entered multi-function chambers
Compact branch/rejoin loops as small reusable authoring modules
Nonnatural mechanical fittings rooted into biologically interpreted cliff strata

similarity_avoidance: Unlike Cinderfold Sibling 01 open gabled post sheds or Sibling 02 airy braided two-level trestles, this is an almost entirely cliff-embedded nested-cavity quarter with separate short low-level returns.
